capabilities.name: Sign-On and Access Control
capabilities.description: Authenticates users by user id and password and routes them to the Admin menu or the regular Main menu, from which they select the application functions they may use.

capabilities.name: User Administration
capabilities.description: Lets administrators list, add, update and delete application users, including their names, passwords and user type.

capabilities.name: Account Management
capabilities.description: View and update credit-card accounts and their customers, with extensive validation of account and customer details, plus account inquiry over MQ and batch account and customer extracts.

capabilities.name: Card Management
capabilities.description: List, view and update credit cards (embossed name, active status, expiry date) and browse the card master and card-to-account cross-reference.

capabilities.name: Transaction Entry and Posting
capabilities.description: Online listing, viewing and manual entry of transactions, and the daily batch that verifies each transaction and posts it to account balances or rejects it with a reason.

capabilities.name: Interest and Bill Payment
capabilities.description: Computes and posts monthly interest on account category balances using disclosure-group rates, and lets a user pay an account's full outstanding balance online.

capabilities.name: Statements and Reporting
capabilities.description: Produces account statements in text and HTML and the transaction detail report for a requested date range, which users request online as Monthly, Yearly or Custom reports.

capabilities.name: Card Authorization
capabilities.description: Real-time approve/decline of card authorization requests against available credit and card status, review of pending authorizations, fraud marking, and purge, load and unload of the pending-authorization database.

capabilities.name: Transaction Type Reference Data
capabilities.description: Maintains the transaction type and category reference data online (list, update) and through a batch update of transaction-type records.

capabilities.name: Data Migration and Shared Services
capabilities.description: Exports and imports all CardDemo master data for branch migration, and provides shared services such as date validation, an MQ date/account service and a timed wait utility.

COND-CBACT01C-1300-POPUL-ACCT-RECORD-1.name: Default a zero cycle debit to 2525.00 in the account extract
COND-CBACT01C-1300-POPUL-ACCT-RECORD-1.description: When the account extract finds that the account's current-cycle debit is zero, it writes 2525.00 into that field of the output record. This hard-coded value should be confirmed with the business.

COND-CBACT04C-MAIN-PARA-5.name: Compute interest only when the interest rate is not zero
COND-CBACT04C-MAIN-PARA-5.description: During interest posting, interest for a transaction-category balance is computed only when the rate found for the account's disclosure group is not zero. Monthly interest is the category balance times the rate divided by 1200.

COND-CBPAUP0C-MAIN-PARA-3.name: Delete a pending-authorization detail that qualifies for deletion
COND-CBPAUP0C-MAIN-PARA-3.description: The authorization purge deletes a pending-authorization detail record when it has been marked as qualified for deletion (older than the expiry window).

COND-CBPAUP0C-MAIN-PARA-4.name: Delete an authorization summary with no approved authorizations left
COND-CBPAUP0C-MAIN-PARA-4.description: The purge deletes a pending-authorization summary when its count of approved authorizations is zero or less.

COND-CBPAUP0C-1000-INITIALIZE-1.name: Use a 5-day authorization expiry window unless a valid one is supplied
COND-CBPAUP0C-1000-INITIALIZE-1.description: The purge takes the expiry window (in days) from its run parameter when that parameter is numeric; otherwise it uses a default of 5 days.

COND-CBPAUP0C-4000-CHECK-IF-EXPIRED-1.name: Qualify a pending authorization for deletion when it is older than the expiry window
COND-CBPAUP0C-4000-CHECK-IF-EXPIRED-1.description: A pending-authorization detail qualifies for deletion when its age is greater than the expiry window in days.

COND-CBTRN02C-MAIN-PARA-3.name: Post a daily transaction only when it passes every validation
COND-CBTRN02C-MAIN-PARA-3.description: A daily transaction is posted when no validation failure reason has been set; otherwise it is rejected and written to the rejects file with its numbered reason.

COND-CBTRN02C-1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT-2.name: Reject a transaction that would take the account over its credit limit
COND-CBTRN02C-1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT-2.description: A daily transaction is accepted only if the account credit limit is greater than or equal to the resulting balance; otherwise it is rejected with reason 102.

COND-CBTRN02C-1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT-3.name: Reject a transaction dated after the account expiration date
COND-CBTRN02C-1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT-3.description: A daily transaction is accepted only if the account expiration date is on or after the transaction date; otherwise it is rejected with reason 103.

COND-CBTRN02C-2800-UPDATE-ACCOUNT-REC-1.name: Treat zero or positive amounts as credits and negative amounts as debits
COND-CBTRN02C-2800-UPDATE-ACCOUNT-REC-1.description: When a posted transaction updates the account, an amount of zero or more is applied as a current-cycle credit and a negative amount as a current-cycle debit.

COND-CBTRN03C-MAIN-PARA-2.name: Report only transactions processed within the requested date range
COND-CBTRN03C-MAIN-PARA-2.description: The transaction detail report includes a transaction only when its processing date falls between the start and end dates read from the date parameter file; other transactions are skipped.

COND-COBIL00C-PROCESS-ENTER-KEY-2.name: Handle the bill-payment confirmation answer
COND-COBIL00C-PROCESS-ENTER-KEY-2.description: The bill payment screen evaluates the user's confirmation entry and handles Y, N, blank and any other value as separate cases.

COND-COBIL00C-PROCESS-ENTER-KEY-3.name: Refuse a bill payment when there is nothing to pay
COND-COBIL00C-PROCESS-ENTER-KEY-3.description: If the account's current balance is zero or less, no payment is made and the user is told there is nothing to pay.

COND-COBIL00C-PROCESS-ENTER-KEY-4.name: Pay the full outstanding balance only after the user confirms
COND-COBIL00C-PROCESS-ENTER-KEY-4.description: When the user confirms payment, a payment transaction is created for the full outstanding balance and the account balance is set to zero.

COND-COPAUA0C-MAKE-AUTH-DECISION-1.name: Decline an authorization when the card is inactive
COND-COPAUA0C-MAKE-AUTH-DECISION-1.description: An authorization request is declined if the card is not active.

COND-COPAUA0C-MAKE-AUTH-DECISION-2.name: Decline an authorization when the card has expired
COND-COPAUA0C-MAKE-AUTH-DECISION-2.description: An authorization request is declined if the card is expired.

COND-COPAUA0C-MAKE-AUTH-DECISION-3.name: Decline an authorization that exceeds the available credit
COND-COPAUA0C-MAKE-AUTH-DECISION-3.description: If the transaction amount is greater than the available credit computed for the account, the request is declined as over-limit.

COND-COPAUA0C-MAKE-AUTH-DECISION-4.name: Approve an authorization that passes all decline checks
COND-COPAUA0C-MAKE-AUTH-DECISION-4.description: When none of the decline conditions (inactive card, expired card, over available credit) apply, the authorization request is approved.

COND-CORPT00C-PROCESS-ENTER-KEY-1.name: Offer Monthly, Yearly or Custom date-range transaction reports
COND-CORPT00C-PROCESS-ENTER-KEY-1.description: The report request screen accepts one of three report types: Monthly, Yearly or a Custom date range, and validates the selection and dates before the report is submitted.

COND-COSGN00C-READ-USER-SEC-FILE-2.name: Reject sign-on when the password does not match
COND-COSGN00C-READ-USER-SEC-FILE-2.description: If the password stored in the user security file differs from the one entered, sign-on fails with a wrong-password message.

COND-COSGN00C-READ-USER-SEC-FILE-3.name: Send administrators to the Admin menu and other users to the Main menu
COND-COSGN00C-READ-USER-SEC-FILE-3.description: After a successful sign-on, a user whose type is Admin is transferred to the Admin menu; every other user is transferred to the Main menu.

COND-COTRN02C-PROCESS-ENTER-KEY-1.name: Add a transaction only when its key and data fields are valid
COND-COTRN02C-PROCESS-ENTER-KEY-1.description: A new transaction record is written only when both the account/card key and the transaction data fields pass validation.

COND-COTRN02C-VALIDATE-INPUT-DATA-FIELDS.name: Reject a transaction amount that is not a valid signed number
COND-COTRN02C-VALIDATE-INPUT-DATA-FIELDS.description: On the Add Transaction screen, an amount that is not a valid signed number is rejected with an error.

COND-COUSR03C-PROCESS-ENTER-KEY-3.name: Delete a user only after the deletion is confirmed
COND-COUSR03C-PROCESS-ENTER-KEY-3.description: A user security record is deleted only after the administrator confirms the deletion.

COND88-CIPAUDTY-PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE.name: Treat response code 00 as an approved authorization
COND88-CIPAUDTY-PA-AUTH-RESP-CODE.description: A pending authorization with response code 00 is an approved authorization.

COND88-CIPAUDTY-PA-MATCH-STATUS.name: Track the match status of each pending authorization
COND88-CIPAUDTY-PA-MATCH-STATUS.description: A pending authorization's match status is P (pending), D (authorization declined), E (pending expired) or M (matched with a transaction).

COND88-CIPAUDTY-PA-AUTH-FRAUD.name: Record whether fraud is confirmed or removed on an authorization
COND88-CIPAUDTY-PA-AUTH-FRAUD.description: The fraud indicator on a pending authorization is F when fraud is confirmed and R when the fraud flag has been removed.

COND88-COCOM01Y-CDEMO-USER-TYPE.name: Classify every user as an administrator or a regular user
COND88-COCOM01Y-CDEMO-USER-TYPE.description: User type is A for an administrator or U for a regular user; it is carried with the user's session across the online programs.

COND88-CSLKPCDY-WS-US-PHONE-AREA-CODE-TO.name: Accept only recognised US phone area codes
COND88-CSLKPCDY-WS-US-PHONE-AREA-CODE-TO.description: A phone area code is valid only if it appears in the list of valid area codes, which combines general-purpose codes (such as 201, 202 and 203) with easily recognisable codes (200, 211, 222 and so on up to 999).

COND88-CSLKPCDY-US-STATE-CODE-TO-EDIT.name: Accept only valid US state and territory codes
COND88-CSLKPCDY-US-STATE-CODE-TO-EDIT.description: A state code must be one of the 50 US state codes, DC, or the territory codes AS, GU, MP, PR and VI.

COND88-CSLKPCDY-US-STATE-AND-FIRST-ZIP2.name: Require the ZIP code to be consistent with the state
COND88-CSLKPCDY-US-STATE-AND-FIRST-ZIP2.description: The state code combined with the first two digits of the ZIP code must be a recognised combination, for example CA with 90 to 96 or NY with 10 to 14.

COND88-CSUTLDWY-WS-EDIT-DATE-CC-N.name: Recognise only the 19xx and 20xx centuries in entered dates
COND88-CSUTLDWY-WS-EDIT-DATE-CC-N.description: When a date is edited, its century is recognised as 20 (this century) or 19 (last century).

COND88-CSUTLDWY-WS-EDIT-DATE-MM-N.name: Require a month between 1 and 12 in entered dates
COND88-CSUTLDWY-WS-EDIT-DATE-MM-N.description: The month of an entered date must be 1 through 12; months 1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10 and 12 are treated as 31-day months and month 2 as February.

COND88-CSUTLDWY-WS-EDIT-DATE-DD-N.name: Require a valid day of the month in entered dates
COND88-CSUTLDWY-WS-EDIT-DATE-DD-N.description: The day of an entered date must be 1 through 31, with days 29, 30 and 31 checked separately; a February day is valid from 1 through 28.

COND88-COACTUPC-WS-EDIT-US-SSN-PART1-N.name: Reject a Social Security Number with an invalid first part
COND88-COACTUPC-WS-EDIT-US-SSN-PART1-N.description: The first three digits of a Social Security Number are invalid if they are 000, 666, or anywhere from 900 to 999.

COND88-COACTUPC-WS-EDIT-ACCT-STATUS.name: Require the account active status to be Y or N
COND88-COACTUPC-WS-EDIT-ACCT-STATUS.description: On account update, the account active status is valid only when it is Y or N.

COND88-COACTUPC-WS-EDIT-PRI-CARDHOLDER.name: Require the primary cardholder indicator to be Y or N
COND88-COACTUPC-WS-EDIT-PRI-CARDHOLDER.description: On account update, the primary cardholder indicator is valid only when it is Y or N.

COND88-COACTUPC-ACUP-NEW-CUST-FICO-SCORE.name: Require a FICO score between 300 and 850
COND88-COACTUPC-ACUP-NEW-CUST-FICO-SCORE.description: When a customer's FICO score is updated, the new score must be between 300 and 850.

COND88-COCRDUPC-CARD-MONTH-CHECK-N.name: Require a card expiry month between 1 and 12
COND88-COCRDUPC-CARD-MONTH-CHECK-N.description: On card update, the expiry month must be 1 through 12.

COND88-COCRDUPC-CARD-YEAR-CHECK-N.name: Require a card expiry year between 1950 and 2099
COND88-COCRDUPC-CARD-YEAR-CHECK-N.description: On card update, the expiry year must be 1950 through 2099.

COND88-COPAUA0C-WS-AUTH-RESP-FLG.name: Answer each authorization request as approved or declined
COND88-COPAUA0C-WS-AUTH-RESP-FLG.description: The authorization response is A for approved or D for declined.

COND88-COPAUA0C-WS-DECLINE-FLG.name: Record the approve or decline decision for each authorization
COND88-COPAUA0C-WS-DECLINE-FLG.description: The authorization decision is held as A (approve) or D (decline).

COND88-COPAUA0C-WS-DECLINE-REASON-FLG.name: Classify the reason for a declined authorization
COND88-COPAUA0C-WS-DECLINE-REASON-FLG.description: A decline reason is one of: insufficient funds (I), card not active (A), account closed (C), card fraud (F) or merchant fraud (M).

COND88-COPAUS1C-WS-FRD-ACTION.name: Allow an authorization to be reported as fraud or cleared of fraud
COND88-COPAUS1C-WS-FRD-ACTION.description: From the authorization detail view a user can report fraud (F) on the selected authorization or remove a fraud flag (R).
